summary: Thiscall wrapper that first calls VTableSetterWithSubCall (0x00475040) to configure the object, then, when bit 0 of flag argument a2 is set, frees the object itself through FreeWrapper_7bcf(this). Always returns the original this pointer, even after it has been freed. Structurally mirrors the ShortComputation_4c50 wrapper with a different setup callee.

local_names.a2: flag byte; bit 0 selects whether the object is freed

operations.description: Call VTableSetterWithSubCall() to set up the object. The packet source shows the call without an explicit argument; as a thiscall-family call it is expected to use the enclosing this pointer.
Guard on (a2 & 1) != 0; only when bit 0 of the flag argument is set does the function free the object.
Call FreeWrapper_7bcf(this) to free the object when the guard holds.
Return this regardless of whether the object was freed.
